_about: Comfort (Dave 2026-10-31, from Valheim; the meter Dave 2026-11-23): the furniture and fire a player enjoys nearby, and the comfort meter they feed. See docs/COMFORT_DESIGN.md.

meter._about: The comfort meter (Dave 23 Nov 2026): always on, 0 to max. It climbs toward the level the points below add up to and drifts down by what the player does. The bonus is the whole level shown x 10 percent of full_bonus (10 = all of it, 6 = 60 percent, 0 = none). Replaces the timed Rested buff (rested below is kept only for old saves, read by nothing).
meter.points_note: Dave 23 Nov 2026: shelter 1, warmed by a fire 1, food above 25 percent 1, above 50 percent 1, water above 50 percent 1, on a bed 1, clothing a point or two. dressed = something worn on body, legs and feet; dressed_fine = and none of it plant fibre. furniture (thread's pick for the rest of 10) = the points of the comfort kinds below in radius while sheltered, beds and fires left out (they have their own point), up to furniture_max.
meter.rates_note: Points a REAL minute. Below the target it rises at rise_per_min (x rise_rest_mult sitting, lying or asleep). Above the target it falls at fall_per_min (about 1 point in 7 minutes walking about), x fall_rest_mult resting, up to x fall_run_mult at full exertion (running), x fall_wet_mult soaked through (scaled by how wet), x fall_cold_mult cold (under the cold line).
meter.bonus_note: At level 10. damage_taken 0.5 = health counts double (blows do half), so saved health values never change; exhaustion 0.5 = exertion (strain) and tiredness (energy) build at half speed; hunger_thirst 0.5 = food and water last twice as long. regen, action speed, skill gain and cold carry over from the old Rested top tier. Each scales in a straight line with the level; food effects still take the larger, never both.

counts: inside a built roof (lean-to, roof piece)
under a grown tree crown (Cover.at, trees at 80 percent of species height)
shelter.note: The player must be sheltered for any furniture to count. Standing near the items is enough; you do not have to be in the lean-to.

rules.one_bed_counts: only the best bed within the radius counts (you sleep in one)
rules.best_grade_counts: graded furniture (a kind with a grade: crude, rustic, fine, ornate; master s3.5) counts once per family (chair, table, bench, board chest), only the best grade within the radius, as the bed does, so grades never stack but a bench and a chair both count; kinds with no grade count by kind
rules.lit_only: fires, torches and chandeliers count only while lit; a laid, unlit or burnt-out fire gives 0
rules.same_floor: items within height_m above or below the player's feet

kinds.source: campfire (structure live; counts only while lit)
wicker_basket (blueprint 157; takes the retired Wicker - Chest's place, Dave 21 Nov 2026)

earned_by: sleep or lie in a bed at that level
sit on a seat at that level for 30 s
lie on the ground at level 2 or more for 60 s (shorter buff)
rested.note: A game hour is 2.5 real minutes: 45 real minutes is 18 game hours. A new buff of a higher or equal level refreshes the timer and sets the tier; it never stacks.
rested.duration_note: Dave 31 Oct: the buff ALWAYS lasts the same time, about 45 REAL minutes; the comfort level scales the BONUSES, not the time. Game-time length is computed from the game clock (GameClock.RATIO = 24 game hours per real hour, so 45 real minutes = 18 game hours); never hard-code game units. Resting again refreshes the 45 minutes while the comfort level is at least that of the current buff (a higher level replaces the tier); resting at a lower level changes nothing.
rested.refresh_rule: on a completed rest at level L: if no buff, or L >= buff.level: buff = {level: L, until: now + 45 real minutes}; else leave it
rested.retired_note: Retired 23 Nov 2026 by the comfort meter (meter above); kept so old saves and notes read; nothing reads the tiers.

bed_json_fold: data/items/bed.json comfort 1 for the rough bed stays; its regen_mult 1.25 and drain_mult 0.5 are the SLEEP bonus and stack with Rested only for regen (take the larger, do not multiply) so a comfortable bed cannot double up.

hud.comfort_icon: a hearth icon with the level number; grey at 0 to 1, warm at 2 and above
hud.rested_icon: a moon-and-cup icon with a countdown in minutes
tooltip: Missing: a rug, a lit torch (+2 more)
Rested: +20% health regeneration, -15% exhaustion, 24 min left

messages.unsheltered: You are not sheltered: nothing here comforts you.
messages.low: It is too bare to rest well here (comfort 2 needed).
